newsitem.title: USA: Auto sales in U.S. up 2.5 pct March 11-20 wk - CNW.
newsitem.headline: Auto sales in U.S. up 2.5 pct March 11-20 wk - CNW.

text.p: Auto sales in the United States advanced 2.5 percent in the 10 days of March 11-20 compared with the same period a year ago, according to a report by CNW Marketing/Research.
During the survey period, sales of domestic autos rose 1.7 percent, while U.S. sales of imports climbed 6.4 percent.
Specifically, domestic car sales slipped 1.0 percent, to 185,646 from 187,582, CNW said. Domestic truck sales increased 4.6 percent, to 187,681 from 179,502, it said.
Import car sales rose 3.8 percent to 64,836, and import truck sales jumped 18.6 percent to 15,552, the report said.
About 2.95 million vehicles were sold in the United States so far in 1997, up 0.38 percent from the same period of 1996, according to CNW.
